body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D7sHdFfY8QjwRsxKSLngGfv)_

Part of #25920 — slice 3 of the unwired-tooling cleanup (slices 1 and 2: #26004, #26024). The card stays open.

## Summary

Deletions only: 3 files, −1,147 lines, on `main` bbf70614.

- `ui/scripts/page-key-read-census.mjs` + its test + the `census:page-key-reads` alias → **delete.** It was the instrument a renderer-vs-`PageSchema` page-key gate would have read; that card (objectui#9438) was closed as not planned on 2026-09-22. No gate or workflow reads it; nothing but its own test and the alias names it.

## Scope changes found while preparing this slice

Two scripts the #26004 table listed as delete candidates are **not** dead and move to the maintainer list instead:

- `tsconfig-test-parity-census.mjs` — five test comments in `ui/packages/plugin-designer` and one in `ui/packages/fields/tsconfig.test.json` deliberately tell readers to read the `lib` level off `pnpm census:tsconfig-test-parity` instead of restating it (objectui#9513). A live hand-run instrument.
- `dollar-dialect-alias-census.mjs` — deleting its test turns two cells of `ui/scripts/__tests__/markdown-test-inputs.test.ts` red ("EVERY tracked markdown document is an input", objectui#9096): its `trackedFiles()` walk is the read that makes that class total, so removing it would change which PRs the CI markdown exclusions let skip the test shards. That is a CI behaviour change, not cleanup.
- Likewise `check-component-surface-parity.mjs`: `ui/packages/types/src/navigation.ts` and `ui/packages/plugin-map/src/index.tsx` point readers at `pnpm check:component-surface-parity`.

Remaining delete work: `changeset-polarity-census` (its card objectui#9727 closed after the rebuild), split in two PRs to stay under the 3,000-line threshold. Then the mechanical tsconfig dedupe.

## Verification (head 714e17ee)

- Exact-name `git grep` across the whole tree for the script, its test and the alias: no hits outside the deleted files.
- ui suites that read the scripts inventory and manifest (markdown-test-inputs, package-scripts-vitest-projects, check-unreferenced-sources, ci-cd-pipeline-doc, vitest-invocation-guard): 5 files, 192 tests passed. `check:unreferenced-sources` and `check:test-path-roots` exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` families: per-family exit codes in the report on the card.
- No changeset: private ui tooling and the private ui root manifest only.
